videos.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs
videos.description: How dogs are trained to use smell for life-saving conservation work and environmental policing. Featuring a South African dog helping to monitor endangered tortoises, a labrador who ensures that non-native zebra mussels do no damage to the habitats of Western Canada, and a whale scat detection dog, who plays a vital role in research into the decline of orca whales.

videos.title: My Best Friend's an Animal
videos.description: Animals that have unlikely friendships with humans, beginning with Sirga the lion, whose human pal, Val, has been by her side since she was an orphaned cub.

videos.title: Reef Wrecks
videos.description: The Bahamas is the underwater movie capital of the world. For decades, Hollywood has come here to make epic movies and TV shows in its crystal waters.

videos.title: Animals Like Us
videos.description: A fish cleans a shark's pearly white teeth, two giraffes have a cuddle and a monkey shows off his toolbox.

videos.title: Baboons: Rules of the Troop
videos.description: Cameras follow four different species of baboons who have conquered African deserts, coasts, savannah and mountains, adapting to the challenges of their environment along the way.

videos.title: Great Lakes Wild
videos.description: The push to increase the population numbers of Ontario's eight turtle species, seven of which are listed as endangered. But turtles are slow and not entirely smart.

videos.title: Great Lakes Wild
videos.description: A dam is an engineering feat that controls massive amounts of water. But as this episode shows, it can also wreak havoc on the animals that call those waters home.

videos.title: Planet Weird
videos.description: Meeting nature's oddballs and mavericks, revealing the bizarre behaviours and ingenious adaptations that help remarkable animals survive.

videos.title: Big Cats, Nine Lives
videos.description: Following leopards through harsh landscapes, where stealth and cunning help them outwit rivals, find food and protect their young against the odds.

videos.title: Valley of Flood and Fire
videos.description: Documentary following the Luangwa Valley's transition from lush paradise to parched desert. It's the end of November and the rains have begun, ending a brutal dry season and beginning the transition to luscious wetland.

videos.title: Valley of Flood and Fire
videos.description: As the dry season takes hold in Luangwa Valley, lagoons dry up and verdant grasslands gradually turn to dust. Animals must take advantage while they can.

videos.title: Valley of Flood and Fire
videos.description: The documentary about the Luangwa Valley considers how the life of every animal is linked to the vastly different seasons - the wet and the dry.

videos.title: Secret World of Sound with David Attenborough
videos.description: The broadcaster explores the ways different creatures hear and produce sound and how it can influence their decisions, using cutting-edge audio technology to reveal a new perspective and understanding of animal behaviour.

videos.title: Secret World of Sound with David Attenborough
videos.description: From melodic songs to strange hums, David Attenborough shares the sounds that gibbons, lyrebirds, bull elk and more use to find a mate - and warn off the competition.

videos.title: Secret World of Sound with David Attenborough
videos.description: A look at how baby animals communicate in their quest for survival, using sound to beg and call for help in the early days of life.

videos.title: Deadly Australians
videos.description: In the depths of Australia's oceans lurks a killer crew of creatures. Discover the deadliest of them all.

videos.title: Shark Squad
videos.description: The mako, a relatively unstudied shark species, which has the advantages of a quick-thinking brain and astounding speed.

videos.title: Snow Leopards with Dan O'Neill
videos.description: Part one of two. Biologist and naturalist Dan O'Neill sets out on a mission to protect one of Earth's most elusive creatures - the snow leopard.

videos.title: Snow Leopards with Dan O'Neill
videos.description: Part two of two. Navigate the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan as he searches for the largest snow leopard ever recorded, known as 'the Dude'.

videos.description: Anna chases the Nomads out of her territory, then join Mia in her birthing den, before kicking back with the Mangrove Family as they pal around with stray dogs.

videos.description: Mia and her newborn pups go swimming, before welcoming in an era of otter peace as the Mangrove Family becomes a park's main attraction.

videos.description: Meeting some uniquely curious animals, including brushtail possums, parrots, numbats and more.

videos.description: A flock of cedar waxwings takes over the centre's aviary and keeps the staff busy with endless demands for food.

videos.title: City Wildlife Rescue
videos.description: The rescue team undertakes a madcap chase after a red-tailed hawk - he can't fly, but he can certainly run. Plus, rare albino squirrel recovers from being unwell.

videos.title: Slovenia: Where Nature Comes First
videos.description: The natural wonders of Slovenia, from Mediterranean olive groves to snow-capped peaks, as well as wildlife such as brown bears and the world's largest trout.

videos.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters
videos.description: Following polar bears hunting for seals, macaques bathing in natural hot springs, and Arctic foxes trying out a unique survival strategy.

videos.title: Flying Monsters with David Attenborough
videos.description: The broadcaster explores the world of the pterosaur, a flying creature that occupied the skies 200 million years ago. Visiting sites around the world, from the Dorset coast to New Mexico, he explains how the reptiles evolved to defy the forces of gravity, and examines the features of their anatomy that can still be seen in present-day descendents. He also discovers why they became extinct after dominating the skies for millions of years.

videos.title: David Attenborough's Natural History Museum Alive
videos.description: The broadcaster invites viewers to join him as he takes an after-hours stroll around one of his favourite places, the Natural History Museum. But this is no ordinary tour as some of the many exhibits spring to life as the veteran naturalist strolls along.

videos.title: Planet Weird
videos.description: A look at some of the Earth's harshest environments, where creatures battle the elements to survive.

videos.title: Macaque Island
videos.description: Exploring the lives of two troops of long-tailed macaques residing in the forests of Singapore, revealing the fascinating world of these curious and intelligent primates. Matnoor rules over the 30 members of the Street troop, wihile Aarav is the old alpha male of the wilder Hill troop.

videos.title: Macaque Island
videos.description: The Hill Troop invade the Street Troop's turf, before the Sisterhood plots to kidnap Sara's baby. Meanwhile, alpha Loci discovers his old rival is back.

videos.title: Macaque Island
videos.description: A brawl erupts after the Street Troop finds the Hill Troop on their turf, before alpha wannabe Ajit makes his move.

videos.title: Beasts of the Big Blue
videos.description: Journey to the Cook Islands as 3,000 humpback whales get ready to mate and raise their young. Plus, a glimpse into evolutionary past.

videos.description: The Manzi pack enjoy a kill, the Kakulis watch out for leopards and hyenas, and a returning male of the Stork Colony goes on an epic hunt.

videos.title: Wildlife ER
videos.description: The clinic deals with the aftermath of a flood in Brisbane. A baby kangaroo is in need of round-the-clock care and Karina tackles the turtle waiting list.
